content:
Stephanie Nguyen: Kicking off assignments for the regulated ABM target list (FinServ first, Healthcare secondary). Please reply here if any conflicts.

Stephanie Nguyen: Source of truth is the sheet Ben shared yesterday. We need clean NA vs EMEA coverage + a consistent sequence (SDR-led touches → AE-led meeting ask). No “everyone emails at once” please.

Ben Carter: linking the list again: https://drive.google.com/.../target-account-list-finserv-health (tabs: FinServ v1 + Healthcare v0.6). Current scoring is in col M.

Grace O'Connor: propose: SDR (Rohan) runs Touch 1-2 (email + LI connect), AE runs Touch 3 as direct ask + offer security review / architecture consult. If they engage earlier, AE can jump in immediately.

Rohan Mehta: +1. Also request: pls don’t do parallel LI InMails day-of my Touch 1. I’ll tag you in the task when it’s time to take over.

Lukas Meyer: For EMEA accounts: I can cover assignment + intros, but Hannah should run the deal motion. We’ve got a couple warm pathways via AWS + one prior contact.

Stephanie Nguyen: Draft assignments (FinServ):
- Northbridge Banking (NA, tier 1) → Avery
- Orion Payments (NA, tier 1) → Priyom
- Brightline Insurance (NA, tier 1) → Diego
- Lakeview Credit Union (NA, tier 2) → Avery (unless you’re overloaded)
- Trident Financial Services (NA, tier 1 late-stage intent) → Priyom
- Regal Wealth Management (EMEA, tier 1) → Hannah (Lukas as exec cover)
Reply w/ conflicts or warm intro notes.

Avery Johnson: I can take Northbridge + Lakeview. FYI Northbridge has a semi-warm intro through a board advisor (not direct, but friendly). I’ll keep Touch 3 framed as “security + performance validation” vs generic demo.

Priyom Das: Orion + Trident works. For Trident: do we want to lead with Marketplace/private offer angle or keep it product-first?

Lukas Meyer: For Trident, keep product-first until they raise procurement. When they do, we can pull in the Marketplace thread. Don’t open with “we can do a private offer” unless they’re already in buy mode.

Diego Fernandez: Brightline assigned, good. Heads up they’re *very* audit-log heavy in every convo I’ve had w similar accounts. Would like the first CTA to be “15-min security intake” not benchmark download.

Grace O'Connor: Agree. For regulated personas, CTA = “security + architecture review” is converting better than “get a benchmark PDF.” We can still attach the 1-pager after they respond.

Ben Carter: Yup, CTA decision from Marketing side: primary = security/architecture consult. Secondary = “benchmark plan” if they want a technical next step.

Rohan Mehta: Operational note: I’ll run Touch 1 tomorrow AM local time (8:30a). Touch 2 48h later. AE Touch 3 after that unless there’s engagement earlier.

Stephanie Nguyen: + guardrails: if AE is going to jump in early, just drop a “taking over” note in the HubSpot task so we don’t double-tap.

Isabelle Laurent: Once you confirm, pls update HubSpot “Company owner” + “AE owner” and add the ABM campaign tag: `ABM-Regulated-2025Q2`. If you want, I can do a bulk update if you paste final mapping.

Hannah Schmitt: Regal Wealth is mine. Warm intro: Lukas, I’ll take whatever you have w/ AWS contacts. Also confirm timezone sequencing — I’ll run from CET.

Lukas Meyer: For Regal: I can intro via AWS co-sell team (soft). Also note they asked about SSO/SAML in a prior tooling RFP (we should be ready w/ Security FAQ link + “evidence pack available under NDA”).

Priyom Das: Re: Orion, I have a personal connection to their Head of Platform (worked together at a prior company). I can bypass SDR on that one if we want.

Grace O'Connor: If it’s truly warm, yes — but still log it + keep messaging consistent. Maybe have Rohan do “light touch” and you do the actual ask same day?

Rohan Mehta: Works. I’ll do a short “saw you’re exploring X” note, then Priyom can follow with the meeting ask. Just tell me who/what to reference.

Avery Johnson: Question on Lakeview (tier 2): can we keep it SDR-only until they show engagement? I don’t want to burn cycles if they’re low intent.

Stephanie Nguyen: Yes. Lakeview stays SDR-led until intent signal (reply, click, visit, referral). If they engage, Avery you take over.

Diego Fernandez: For Brightline, I want to time Touch 3 around when Security can respond fast. Naomi/Aisha availability this week?

Ben Carter: Security coverage is tight but Naomi said she can handle evidence routing if we keep asks scoped. Keep initial email language “we can share under NDA” not “we’ll send SOC2 to anyone.”

Isabelle Laurent: pls also set “Next activity date” when you add ownership. Helps the dashboard.

Stephanie Nguyen: Final mapping stands as posted unless any last objections in next hour. I’ll ping exec sponsor separately for Northbridge.

Hannah Schmitt: All good. I’ll draft a Regal-specific angle (auditability + regional isolation + VPC) and share w/ Lukas for quick review.

Priyom Das: Confirmed Orion/Trident. I’ll add notes in HubSpot re: warm relationship for Orion and keep SDR in the loop.

Avery Johnson: Confirmed Northbridge/Lakeview. I’ll update HubSpot now.

Diego Fernandez: Confirmed Brightline. I’ll hold AE Touch 3 until we’re sure Security can turn around questionnaire requests <48h.

Isabelle Laurent: Great — once updates are in, I’ll do a quick QA pass to make sure tags/owners are consistent.

Grace O'Connor: TY. Next: I’ll post the sequencing checklist + “do not say” compliance language in #sales later today.
